name: Brick Collapse
description: Faint mortar joints turn the first clip into a brick wall: one brick of the bottom course is yanked out downward, the steep wedge of bricks it held drops through the hole, and the collapse spreads sideways course by course until the last bricks at the edges tumble out and the second clip stands where the wall was. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of brick courses along the short side of the frame

params.name: origin
params.description: Horizontal position of the pulled brick (0: left, 1: right)

params.name: shading
params.description: Darkness of the mortar joints, brick edges and shadows
